MASTER CALENDAR COURT
Off Calendar Jun-28-2004 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly for trial by Court.

Appearances:
Paul Perdue, Esq. on behalf of plaintiff Hanley Fong as Trustee of the Fong Properties Trust
Robert Morrocco, defendant in pro per

The parties indicated that this matter has settled. Terms of the settlement are as follows:
This matter pertains to premises located at 957 Leavenworth. Defendant Robert Morrocco to pay plaintiff Hanley Fong as Trustee of the Fong Properties Trust the sum of $3,591.00 by July 1, 2004. Defendant to pay also $2,738.00 for six months commencing on August 1, 2004. The parties stipulated for entry of judgment. If defendant is late and does not comply with terms of the stipulation, plaintiff to enter judgment, and have immediate restitution and possession of said premises. If defendant satisfies the terms of the stipulation, plaintiff to file dismissal. Defendant to have use of storage space until Oct. 1, 2004. Stipulation to be circulated and filed with the Court. All parties agreed to the terms of the settlement.

Hon. Robert Dondero; Clerks: D. Boffi/V. Mu Reporter: Jo Ann Bryce (206)
